triggers.name: new_ticket
triggers.description: Triggers when a new ticket is created in Freshservice.

triggers.name: updated_ticket
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing ticket is updated in Freshservice.

triggers.name: new_requester
triggers.description: Triggers when a new requester (user) is created in Freshservice.

triggers.name: updated_requester
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing requester is updated in Freshservice.

triggers.name: new_change
triggers.description: Triggers when a new change request is created in Freshservice.

triggers.name: updated_change
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing change request is updated in Freshservice. Note: newly created changes may also fire this trigger because their updated_at matches created_at.

triggers.name: new_change_task
triggers.description: Triggers when a new task is created on a specific change request.

triggers.name: updated_change_task
triggers.description: Triggers when a task on a specific change request is updated. Note: newly created tasks may also fire this trigger because their updated_at matches created_at.
